bio.text: Lori Goldstein, a Democrat, represents District 29 (Adams and Jefferson counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives.
She took office in January 2026, succeeding Shannon Bird, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was born in Chicago, graduated from Lincoln Senior High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in 1983 and a graduate degree in 1986 from Colorado State University.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
